primary.policy: GitHub CI builds are evidence; only an explicitly selected workflow-dispatch run is release artifact authority.

secondary.policy: Reproduction/debug evidence only; never release artifact authority.

build_root.policy: Use BUILD_DIR=/path for Make-level custom build roots; BC250_BUILD_DIR is internal to helper scripts and must not be supplied independently.

evidence.environment_policy: Record Fedora/container and key tool versions; do not pin the entire Fedora toolchain.

advisory_quality.policy: Run Ruff/ShellCheck, governance/current-guidance checks, the lean five-module suite, and rpmlint for visibility without blocking RPM artifact production.

stages.description: verify release-critical source identity/contracts and pinned sources, then freeze Source0 and spec
build binary/source RPMs from the exact frozen source/spec snapshot; RPM %check runs the small release-critical package test set
verify payload/SRPM rebuild and emit closed binary/source manifests plus release-evidence.json
